summary: Iteration 4 — Frontend-only test of the futuristic dark-theme redesign (framer-motion, aurora, glass, neon glows). Verified end-to-end at 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile. ALL 14 requested test points PASS: boot splash renders+dismisses, login page renders with #06070D bg + 'Bienvenido' gradient title, login flow lands on /pos, glass sidebar with active pill, product grid + add-to-cart, cart-checkout-button clickable WITHOUT force=True (regression preserved), checkout modal opens with cyan amount input + animated change ('Cambio' shown), Stats page renders Recharts SVG with animated counters and shows real data ($229.44, 2 orders, top products), all 6 other pages (Products/Orders/Stats/CashRegister/Cashiers/Settings) render on dark bg with readable content (no contrast issues observed), mobile bottom nav (md:hidden glass-strong) is visible with 5 tabs and active-mobile-pill layoutId, mobile cart bar appears after adding item showing '1 Ver carrito $84.77'. ZERO console errors and ZERO pageerrors across all routes.

issues: The fixed 'Made with Emergent' badge (bottom-right, ~178x40px) overlaps the rightmost tab of the 5-item bottom nav, partially covering the 'Cajeros'/'Ajustes' tab labels. Cosmetic-only — labels still partially readable, taps still work because tab buttons extend left of the badge. Same Emergent-badge constraint flagged in iter_2/iter_3.

CartContent footer changed from `pb-24 md:pb-20` (iter_3 fix) to `pb-24 lg:pb-20`. This means tablets in 768–1023px range now keep the larger 96px bottom padding instead of switching to 80px at 768px. Cosmetic whitespace increase on tablets only; checkout button still clickable.

critical_code_review_comments: Splash overlay in App.js uses z-50 but Toaster/sonner often uses z-100+. Boot splash works correctly (1.4s timeout) but if a toast fires during the splash it may render above. Low priority.

AnimatedNumber.jsx subscribes to MotionValue 'change' inside useEffect and stores in React state — fine, but on rapid value updates this triggers re-renders every frame. Acceptable for cart totals; consider memoization if used in lists.
App.js wraps every route in <PageTransition> via JSX duplication — could be extracted into a single <Outlet/>-style wrapper to reduce duplication.
(carry-over) server.py is still 850+ lines — not addressed since this iteration is frontend-only.
(carry-over) Legacy /api/auth/login + /api/auth/register endpoints still present alongside multi-tenant ones.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing TEST_Hamburguesa, TEST_Burger, tacos de pollo products from prior iterations were used. No new orders created (cart was cleared via Escape, not checkout).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Futuristic redesign is fully working at desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844). Splash screen [data-testid=splash-screen] renders for ~1.4s on boot then dismisses. Body bg = rgb(6,7,13) = #06070D (ink-950) on every page. Mobile bottom nav uses class 'md:hidden glass-strong border-t border-white/5 safe-bottom relative z-20' and contains active-mobile-pill via framer-motion layoutId (6 elements with 'mobile' testid found). Mobile cart bar shows pill-shaped 'Ver carrito + AnimatedNumber($total)' at bottom when cart has items. ZERO console errors. The only cosmetic issue is the Emergent-badge overlapping the rightmost mobile-nav tab — outside dev control and consistent with prior iterations.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issue found. The redesign preserved all data-testids and functional flows verified in iter_3 (cart-checkout-button still clickable without force=True at 1280x800, modal opens, change calculation displays animated counter).
